The line passes through the points \((-1,-5)\) and \((5,-1)\).

1. Find the slope:
\[
m=\frac{-1-(-5)}{5-(-1)}=\frac{4}{6}=\frac{2}{3}
\]

2. Use point-slope form with \((5,-1)\):
\[
y-(-1)=\frac{2}{3}(x-5)
\]
\[
y+1=\frac{2}{3}x-\frac{10}{3}
\]
\[
y=\frac{2}{3}x-\frac{13}{3}
\]

\[
\boxed{y=\frac{2}{3}x-\frac{13}{3}\quad\left(\text{equivalently }2x-3y=13\right)}
\]
